candidate.description: Unmodified production renderer, LOD, occupancy, settle, and interaction policy.

caveats: GitHub-hosted runners are shared and not a stable same-machine timing gate; three repetitions expose spread but do not remove host noise.
Chromium headless paint/composite behavior and software/GPU availability can differ from the managed Mac product environment.
The harness records observed JS heap and trace events; it cannot observe GPU texture residency or production React work without new instrumentation.

imageIngestion.method: Fixture data URLs are prebuilt deterministically; production paste compression is not invoked or timed.

search.method: window.find over the mounted synthetic giant Note.

selection.method: DOM Selection matched a non-whitespace substring rendered by the live synthetic giant Note editor.

copy.method: System clipboard copy was not invoked or read by this browser harness.

accessibility.method: Chromium Accessibility.getFullAXTree static-text count; not a complete assistive-technology audit.
